notes: Low-impact and holiday events now show on your chart, and the strategy news outputs update every second instead of only at bar close.
changelog: Low-impact and holiday events now appear as markers and in the events table. Alerts are still for High and Medium events only.
In live trading, the strategy outputs (in news window, minutes to next High or Medium event) now refresh every second, so a strategy sees the news window on time, even on slow charts.
Two releases with the same name in the same week are no longer merged into one marker.
Your own chart right margin is now restored when the indicator is removed.
Network paths in Alert Sound File are now always ignored for safety, however the slashes are written.
